changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW p35b_r3.collection_vector_stats WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, COALESCE(r.name, c.collection) AS collection, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lvi.chash IS NOT NULL OR lvn.chash IS NOT NULL) AS chunk_count, max(c.created_at) FILTER (WHERE lvi.chash IS NOT NULL OR lvn.chash IS NOT NULL) AS last_write, count(*) AS stored_count, max(c.collection_id) AS collection_id FROM nexus.chunks c LEFT JOIN nexus.catalog_collections r ON r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.collection_id = c.collection_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT m.tenant_id, m.collection_id, m.chash FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.collection_id IS NOT NULL) lvi ON lvi.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND lvi.collection_id = c.collection_id AND lvi.chash = c.chash LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.tenant_id, m.collection, m.chash, bool_or(m.collection_id IS NULL) AS unstamped FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.collection <> '' GROUP BY m.tenant_id, m.collection, m.chash) lvn ON lvn.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND lvn.collection = c.collection AND c.collection <> '' AND lvn.chash = c.chash AND (c.collection_id IS NULL OR lvn.unstamped) GROUP BY c.tenant_id, COALESCE(r.name, c.collection), 3;

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.24
changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW p35b_r3.live_chunks WITH (security_invoker = true) AS SELECT c.tenant_id, COALESCE(r.name, c.collection) AS collection, c.chash, c.chunk_text, COALESCE(c.embedding_384, c.embedding_768, c.embedding_1024)::nexus.vector AS embedding, c.chunk_tsv, c.metadata, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.embedding_384 IS NOT NULL THEN 384 WHEN c.embedding_768 IS NOT NULL THEN 768 WHEN c.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL THEN 1024 END AS dim, c.collection_id FROM nexus.chunks c LEFT JOIN nexus.catalog_collections r ON r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.collection_id = c.collection_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks m JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = m.doc_id WHERE m.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND m.chash = c.chash AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (c.collection_id = m.collection_id OR ((c.collection_id IS NULL OR m.collection_id IS NULL) AND c.collection = m.collection AND c.collection <> '')));
